verdict.rationale: Honeybadger offers natural-language search ('Describe your search' panel) and an MCP server that lets AI assistants run BadgerQL queries, manage projects, and investigate errors conversationally, plus a Slack bot with natural-language-like commands (e.g., 'show fault #'). This covers meaningful natural-language interaction but is scoped to specific features (search, MCP, Slack) rather than the whole product surface. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language commands across the full dashboard/UI (not just search and MCP), independent/hands-on validation of the NL search quality, and any first-party claim of a general conversational interface beyond MCP/Slack.
